subject: Re: OEM Core Switching Solution
text:
Hi, Shantanu,

1, Please check attached info.
It is about a typical model and our operation system.
This will help you roughly understand our technical capabilities.

2, About MII
2.1. Start with SKD units for initial testing – simple and quick.
2.2. Progress to CKD if deeper localization is needed.
3.3. Software and other compliance details can be handled as the project
advances.

3. We need to know your plans about MII.
Are you doing your own brand or just introducing some certain models for
local projects?
etc.

4. We suggest starting with sample testing. This helps you evaluate the
hardware, WEB UI, and confirm your MII requirements.

Thank you.
